name: Ledesma (Spain)
description: Blue field with a yellow horizontal stripe across the centre, charged towards the hoist with the crowned arms of Ledesma (a bridge above waves and a knight on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Ledesma; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Ledesma arms — bridge above waves and knight on blue
